old: value = settings[layer] if layer in ("terrain","mulch","stress") else effective_shade(world,i) if layer == "shade" else getattr(cell,layer)
new: value = settings[layer] if layer in ("terrain","mulch","stress") else cell.shade if layer == "shade" else getattr(cell,layer)
check:
from mosslight.engine import create
from mosslight.charts import render_map
w=create(13,4,4)
for c in w.cells: c.shade=40
w.workbench["tiles"][5]["structure"]="shade_cloth"
s=render_map(w,"shade")
assert ">55</text>" in s
expected_fix: A nearby shade cloth contributes to displayed effective shade.
difficulty_rationale: Unmeasured estimate: a local formula, boundary, ordering or data-shape regression. Reproduction may take minutes to a few hours; no multi-hour minimum is claimed.
realism_rationale: Rendering stored shade instead of the derived effective value is a realistic mismatch between data and the map layer contract.
overlap_audit: This replacement changes one decision point in the named contract. The check targets that contract directly and does not depend on another seeded behavior.

contract: History chart x positions use actual day spacing.
symptom: A gap in saved history is rendered as evenly spaced observations.
root_cause: Chart x coordinates use list position instead of recorded days.
check:
from mosslight.engine import create
w=create(14,4,4); h=w.workbench["history"]; h.extend([{"day":2,"moisture":50,"nutrients":50,"vitality":50,"occupied":1,"births":0,"losses":0},{"day":3,"moisture":50,"nutrients":50,"vitality":50,"occupied":1,"births":0,"losses":0},{"day":10,"moisture":50,"nutrients":50,"vitality":50,"occupied":1,"births":0,"losses":0}])
from mosslight.charts import render_history
s=render_history(w,"moisture")
assert ">Day 2</text>" in s and ">Day 10</text>" in s and 'cx="142.50"' in s
